title: Counterexample weighted influence sum
statement: For the specified function $F$ on the three-dimensional sign cube and its specified randomized decision tree $T$, let $\\operatorname{Inf}_i(F)$ be the squared $L^2$ norm of the coordinate-$i$ product Laplacian, and let $q_i$ be the probability that $T$ queries coordinate $i$ on a uniformly random input. Then $\\sum_{i=0}^2 q_i\\operatorname{Inf}_i(F)=(20+9\\sqrt3)/16$.
caveat: The supplied formal statement refers to the counterexample function and randomized decision tree by name but omits the tree definition, so the objects cannot be fully specified from this payload.
